rule: scan to basket; the receipt is the CV
title: Aisle 7
description: Twenty-eight projects on three shelves. Scan the work you want, then print a real receipt of your shortlist.
signature: Three-face project boxes meet a scanner sweep. Each scan adds real project facts to a thermal receipt, ready for 80 mm printing.
holdback: Each box is now a product (channel colour, Anton name, framed screenshot window, one fact on the price tag) and the receipt prints like a thermal till. Two of three shelves fit the first desktop viewport, so 19 of 28 boxes need a sideways scroll or a filter. Many own-label boxes share two blues and a green, so the shelf rhythm is calm but repetitive. The flight and the paper feed were checked frame by frame in paused captures, not at full speed on a real device.
